# Shared source-contract consumer repair

The PR419 and PR420 Rust jobs at `6a4aa2c0` and `129e12c0` passed their
twelve Rust checks, then failed the third shared source-contract command.
It still checked the unchanged phase-layout first source's retired
`std::quantum::t` import. The [first index](first-index.json) binds
[sixteen retained files](first.records.json.gz), including both full hosted
logs/provider responses, exact Git-U consumers and the separate local source
and JSON diagnostic. Initial repair-unit and Cargo-invocation mistakes are
explicitly identified terminal summaries, not complete raw streams.

The separate current project changes only that import to `std::gate::t`.
Its three unitary bodies, complete Bit/Unit interfaces, returned axis order
and observing Unit entry remain unchanged. The shared consumer validates the
existing explicit migration chain and source hashes, then calls the selected
compiler. Changed history refuses before invocation; compiler refusal propagates.
The ten-command selection and 900-second command limits remain unchanged.

Two other old test expectations are repaired. Checked requests contributed by
ordinary bundled source do not imply an independently checked entry contract.
The existing selected-Raw reset refusal now points exactly to `discard(q)` in
ordinary embedded `std::state`, rather than its former sealed caller. Reset
remains unsupported in that profile; false pure labels still refuse.

The [validation index](validation-index.json) binds
[37 original observer/report/log files](validation.records.json.gz). It retains
the failed JSON expectation, the separate reset-span failure and their retries.
The final invocation passes all ten source-contract commands in one stable
source/CLI/checker window. Separately, 92 fixture and 12 CI unit tests pass.
JSON CLI tests pass with two Linux-only filesystem tests skipped on macOS;
hosted Linux coverage remains required. Public effects pass all 38 checks:
9 accepts, 28 effect refusals and one refusal for unsupported reset, with all
43 original inputs and 18 false-pure refusals retained.

The rebuilt normal CLI is `0266bd9c…`; the unchanged selected native checker
is `bd2bb0c3…`. Local Python 3.14 results are not a hosted Python 3.11 profile
pass. These records do not establish compiler/source/runtime/target preservation,
broader QS/PR/RS/EXACT discharge, latest-head CI, issue completion or release
readiness. No new Rust/Lean semantic rule, budget increase or maximum-size case
is introduced. Passive retention decodes/checks bytes without executing history.
